description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/email/check (base $0.003; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?email=name@example.com (one address per call). Email address check for one address: RFC 5322 syntax, MX records (null MX noted), SPF and DMARC records over DNS, role-account flag (info@, admin@ and similar) and a disposable-domain match. No SMTP connection is made, so mailbox existence is not checked. One address per call. Bad input or DNS failure: Not charged. USDC on Base only.
name: email_check_quote
title: Email Address Check Payment Quote
